request: Round trip to Mexico City, out December 9 and back December 12, for the distributor kickoff. Nonstop both ways if policy allows; economy.

trip.supervisor: Laura Pierce, Vice President, International Sales
trip.purpose: Latin America distributor kickoff in Mexico City

must_keep.quote: International travel (travel between continents) requires pre-travel authorization from the employee's ELT representative or Regional President. Such approval should be documented in writing
Pre-travel authorization is not required for travel within the same continent

Travelers are expected to book the lowest logical airfare as determined by the travel agency for travel within a continent based on the following parameters: • Routing requires no more than one connection each way. • Routing does not increase the one-way total elapsed trip time (origin to destination) by more than two hours. • Time Window: Departure/arrival must be no more than two hours before or after requested time. • Savings must be at least $250 of the round-trip coach/economy fare to offset schedule inconvenience.
must_keep.why: the routing tests within a continent

distractors.quote: book flights at least 14 days before your trip begins for travel within a continent and at least 21 days in advance for travel between continents

design_notes: Chicago to Mexico City is within North America, so no pre-travel authorization (288-291) and the within-continent tests apply (438-445): the connection adds 110 minutes each way and saves 26000 cents, so it is the lowest logical airfare. The between-continents $1,000 test would wrongly keep the nonstop. Booked 15 days ahead: 14 days is advice for within a continent anyway.
